verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI supports unattended automation. It runs non-interactively in scripts, emits structured JSON or stream-JSON output, and its GitHub integration performs automated PR reviews, issue triage, and @gemini-cli task delegation. Community users corroborate the automated code review in practice. However, the background execution comes from external harnesses (scripts, GitHub Actions) rather than a native way to schedule or run background automations inside the product. Missing for 10: native scheduling/triggers or a background/daemon mode, documentation on setting up and monitoring long-running autonomous jobs, and evidence of automation beyond GitHub workflows.
